findings.text: ClientManifest constructs UiSystem without resolving the specification's optional exact src/ReplicatedStorage/Project/Client/UI/DerivedUiActionIds.luau source and never forwards derived entries. Consequently a derived project can add the approved game.* action source at its reserved path and bootstrap will silently ignore it, so PRD-REQ-055 and the merged action-catalog contract are not implemented. Resolve only that exact path, require it when present, and inject its duplicate-preserving sequence into UiSystem.

UiRootController falls back from FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") to any child named PlayerGui. It can therefore parent UiRoot under a Folder or other wrong-class instance and return Success even though no usable root was published in the player's actual PlayerGui; UiSystemTestRunner's fixture currently depends on this invalid shape. Require an actual PlayerGui and make the fixture use the correct class or an explicit injectable PlayerGui boundary.

BaseUiElement:AddNestedUiElement prevents only child == self and does not reject attaching an ancestor. For example, after A adds B, B can add A because A still has no parent; this creates a cycle in the supposed ownership tree and later usesContext, collectClaims, Initialize, or Clear recurse without a typed atomic failure. Validate that the proposed child subtree does not already contain the receiving parent before publishing the parent link.

FormController:AddField records a field in _fields, but generic RemoveNestedUiElement does not remove that entry. After a dynamic field removal, GetFieldValue still reads the detached controller and the old name can never be added again, contradicting dynamic ownership removal and the form-owned field-reference contract. Coordinate field removal with the form registry through a typed form removal path or an ownership hook.

TS_TEST_013_ControllerIdentityEvents bypasses the concrete Roblox controller signals by calling EmitAction, Submit, and the context directly, and it registers only one successful root listener. It therefore does not verify the assigned semantic mappings (pointer, Activated, TextBox focus/unfocus/confirm, form cancel), TextBox callback payload exclusion, or the required error/yield listener non-blocking behavior. Add representative signal-driven and failing/yielding-listener partitions required by PRD-AC-011, PRD-AC-012, PRD-AC-021, and PRD-AC-033.

TS_TEST_015_ClientBootstrapComposition tests only UiInitializationCommand's local result-to-throw adapter. It never exercises the existing initialization runner/bootstrap contract required by TS-TEST-015: CommandId = UI attribution, later-command suppression, ClientInitializationFailed without ClientInitialized, and absence of a usable partial UI service. Extend the deterministic test through the existing runner/bootstrap seam rather than treating the throw-string assertion as full composition coverage.

UiSystemTestRunner asserts private implementation state (elementContext._registry and duplicate._parent), despite docs/TestCoverage.md requiring tests to exercise public contracts and not assert private fields or methods. Replace these checks with observable surface assertions, such as exact context keys and post-failure event/claim behavior.
